description: Redesign src/components/layout/BottomTabBar.tsx into a FLOATING, rounded iOS pill tab bar and apply the layout follow-through so no bottom content is hidden behind it: update AppShell reserved bottom space and raise the ToastProvider toast stack. Depends on FEAT-001 (tokens). Presentation/layout only; keep Chrome.tsx route logic exactly as-is; use ONLY the existing tab IconKeys.
steps: BottomTabBar (src/components/layout/BottomTabBar.tsx): make the nav FLOAT - detached from the screen edges with left/right/bottom margins, centered within the max-w-[480px] phone-width column, hovering above the home indicator (use env(safe-area-inset-bottom) / the safe-bottom utility for the bottom offset). Make it fully rounded (rounded-pill), with a frosted/translucent background (bg-surface with alpha) + backdrop-blur, a soft diffuse iOS shadow, and a subtle hairline border.
Keep the four tabs and their EXISTING IconKeys unchanged: tab_home (Home), tab_history (Riwayat), tab_stats (Statistik), tab_profile (Profil). Do not add or rename IconKeys.

Active tab: emerald brand icon+label with a smooth motion/react layoutId pill/blob highlight that springs between tabs (replace the current thin top-bar highlight with a pill/blob behind the active tab); inactive tabs muted (text-content-muted).
Accessibility: keep the nav aria-label; set aria-current='page' on the active Link; ensure each tab hit target is >=44px; add a visible focus style (focus-visible ring) on the links.

AppShell (src/components/layout/AppShell.tsx): replace the withTabBar bottom padding pb-[calc(64px+env(safe-area-inset-bottom))] with reserved space equal to the floating pill height + the bottom gap + env(safe-area-inset-bottom), so bottom-scrolled content and Home's `mt-auto pb-4` Start/Stop controls (FastingTimer) are never covered by the floating pill. Update the component doc comment to describe the floating pill reservation.

ToastProvider (src/components/ui/ToastProvider.tsx): raise the toast stack so it floats above the pill - adjust the hard-coded bottom-20 offset to clear the new reserved space (keep it NOT off-limits; only the offset class changes).
Do NOT modify src/components/layout/Chrome.tsx (route show/hide logic must stay identical). Keep everything emoji-free.
acceptance_criteria: BottomTabBar renders a floating, fully-rounded, translucent (backdrop-blur) pill detached from the edges and centered in the phone-width column, above the safe-area bottom inset.
The active tab shows an emerald icon+label with a motion layoutId pill/blob highlight that animates between tabs; inactive tabs are muted.
nav has aria-label; the active Link has aria-current='page'; tab hit targets are >=44px; links have a visible focus style.
AppShell reserves bottom space accounting for pill height + gap + safe-area so bottom content/CTAs are not hidden; ToastProvider toasts sit above the pill.
Chrome.tsx is unchanged; the bar still shows only on /, /history, /stats, /profile and is hidden on /onboarding and /offline.
No off-limits file was modified; `npm test` passes and `npm run build` succeeds.
verification: Run `npm run build` and confirm it succeeds.
Run `npm test` and confirm all tests pass incl. the no-emoji scan.
Run `git diff -- src/components/layout/Chrome.tsx` and confirm there is NO diff (route logic untouched).
Run `git diff --name-only` and confirm no off-limits path is listed.
findings: BottomTabBar is now a floating iOS pill: an outer pointer-events-none fixed wrapper (inset-x-0 bottom-0, z-50, mx-auto max-w-[480px], px-4, pb-[calc(0.75rem+env(safe-area-inset-bottom))]) positions a pointer-events-auto <nav> that is rounded-pill, bg-[var(--frost-surface)] (the FEAT-001 frosted alpha token), border-hairline, shadow-card, backdrop-blur-xl backdrop-saturate-150. The old thin top-bar highlight was replaced with a motion layoutId='tab-highlight' pill/blob: absolute inset-0 rounded-pill bg-brand-soft behind the active tab (spring stiffness 500 damping 40). Icon+label sit at relative z-10; active = text-brand, inactive = text-content-muted. Links use min-h-[44px] (>=44px hit target), aria-current='page' when active, and focus-visible:ring-2 ring-brand ring-offset-2 for a visible focus style. Only existing IconKeys used (tab_home/tab_history/tab_stats/tab_profile); no new icons; zero emoji. AppShell reserved space changed from pb-[calc(64px+env(safe-area-inset-bottom))] to pb-[calc(56px+1.5rem+env(safe-area-inset-bottom))] = pill height (~56px: p-1.5 + 44px link) + 1.5rem for the pill's bottom gap/breathing + safe-area, so Home's mt-auto pb-4 Start/Stop controls stay clear; doc comment updated. ToastProvider toast stack offset raised from bottom-20 to bottom-[calc(56px+1.5rem+1rem)] so toasts float above the pill (safe-bottom padding retained). Chrome.tsx NOT modified (git diff empty). Verification: npm test 155/155 pass (incl. no-emoji scan); npm run build succeeds with only the pre-existing recommendation.ts _exhaustive ESLint warning. git diff --name-only lists no off-limits path from this feature (layout.tsx/ReminderSettings.tsx/plan.md/review.json were pre-existing uncommitted edits per FEAT-001 findings and were left untouched; only the 3 target files + this JSON are committed).
